summary: This page is the cover of the Alpha Integrated REIT annual report titled 'POWERING GROWTH, FROM WITHIN', which includes a table of contents listing sections such as Overview, Operations Review, Performance, Sustainability & Governance, and Financials. No schema-relevant data (audited Portfolio Statement, Statement of Total Return, gross revenue notes, Top-N tenants, trade/tenant mix, DPU, or manager/trustee/sponsor info) are present on this page.

This page presents the SGX'000 financial highlights for AI-REIT's FY 2025, featuring a rental reversion of +11.8%, a retention ratio of 71.8%, and committed portfolio occupancy of 90.3% as at 31 December 2025.

This page of the SGX REIT annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025 presents key capital management metrics, specifically an aggregate leverage of 35.8% and an average cost of debt of 4.36%, alongside strategic highlights on governance, operational performance, sustainability, portfolio resilience with 90.3% occupancy, prudent capital management including a 3.6x interest coverage ratio, experienced leadership, and future positioning.

This page presents the CEO's letter highlighting AI-REIT's FY 2025 financial performance, specifically noting a Full Year Distribution per Unit (DPU) of SGD'000 increasing 23.4% y-o-y to 3.53 cents and gross revenue reaching an all-time high of $120.1 million since IPO. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as S$ million for revenue figures and cents for DPU, with no audited portfolio statements, tenant tables, or detailed expense notes present on this page.

This page presents the **audited Portfolio Statement** via a map displaying 18 industrial properties across Singapore's four segments (High-Tech, Warehouse & Logistics, Chemical Warehouse & Logistics, and General Industrial) with 90.3% portfolio occupancy as of 31 December 2025, followed by a detailed table listing all 18 property addresses and their respective locations. No other schema-relevant data such as financial statements, tenant details, or distribution figures are present.

This page presents a Property Highlights table detailing the composition of the audited Portfolio Statement across High-Tech Industrial, Warehouse & Logistics, Chemical Warehouses & Logistics, and General Industrial sectors. The artifact lists specific assets such as New Tech Park, 8 Commonwealth Lane, and Penjuru Logistics Hub with their respective descriptions, acquisition/completion dates, and land lease expiry terms, but does not include financial metrics, tenant data, or management information required for other schema categories.

This page presents a Statement of Portfolio (property valuations) for the reporting unit in SGD'000, detailing individual asset purchase prices, valuations as at 31 December 2025, gross floor area, rental income for FY 2025, and occupancy rates. The table aggregates these specific property-level metrics into total portfolio figures showing a combined valuation of $948.9 million and total FY 2025 rental income of $79.1 million across 386,227 sqm.

This page presents the Manager's Review for FY 2025, featuring a **Financial Performance** table reporting gross revenue of SGD'000 (120,076), net property income, finance costs, and adjusted distribution per unit in cents alongside a second table detailing DPU breakdown by half-year. It further includes narrative notes on gross revenue drivers, adjusted income available for distribution, total declared distribution amounts, and a final table showing total assets, liabilities, net assets attributable to unitholders, units in issue, and NAV per unit as at 31 December 2025.

This page presents the NET ASSET VALUE PER UNIT and KEY DEBT FUNDING INDICATORS for SGX REIT as at 31 December 2025, reporting total assets of $1.06 billion, liabilities of $465.1 million, and a NAV per unit increase to $0.53. The main artifact is a table detailing debt funding metrics including $350 million in total borrowings, an aggregate leverage of 35.8%, and a weighted average tenor of 2.0 years, alongside a DEBT MATURITY PROFILE table specifying obligations by year and instrument type (Term Loans, Revolving Facilities, Bonds) in millions of dollars.

This page presents the Manager's Review for FY 2025, featuring a KEY PORTFOLIO STATISTICS table reporting SG$ million and sqm metrics as at 31 December 2025, including 18 properties with a valuation of SG$948.9 million, 90.3% occupancy, and 184 tenants.

This page presents the Asset Type breakdown by NLA, Valuation, and Gross Revenue for Alpha Integrated REIT's portfolio as at 31 December 2025, along with a Lease Structure profile showing Master-leased and Multi-tenanted properties contributing 8.0% and 92.0% of gross revenue respectively in FY 2025. The reporting unit is SGD'000 (S$ million).

This page of the Alpha Integrated REIT annual report for FY 2025 features a "Portfolio Lease Expiry Profile" table detailing lease expiry periods by effective gross rental income, categorized into Single-Tenanted and Multi-Tenanted properties. It also includes a "Portfolio Occupancy" table reporting occupancy rates as at 31 December 2024 and 31 December 2025 across different property types such as High-Tech, General Industrial, Warehouse & Logistics, and Chemical Warehouses & Logistics.

This page presents a Trade Sector Analysis and Top-N Tenants table for Alpha Integrated REIT as of 31 December 2025, detailing the portfolio's gross rental income distribution across 14 sectors with Technology leading at 28.9% and listing the top 10 tenants by percentage contribution.

This page presents the Manager's Review for FY 2025, featuring an Asset Enhancement section detailing plans to add space at New Tech Park@151 Lorong Chuan and an Annual Valuation table showing portfolio values as of 31 December 2025 ($'000) by segment including High-tech Industrial, Warehouse & Logistics, Chemical Warehouses & Logistics, and General Industrial. The table lists specific property valuations in SGD'000 with year-over-year comparisons, driven primarily by gains in High-tech Industrial assets like New Tech Park and 30 & 32 Tuas Avenue 8 due to higher occupancy and master lease securing.

This page presents an independent market review by Knight Frank Singapore, featuring **EXHIBIT 1-3: SINGAPORE INDEX OF INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION, 2016 TO 2025**, which details the Index of Industrial Production (IIP) and annual percentage changes across six manufacturing clusters with a reported year-on-year increase of 8.7% in 2025. The text also includes **EXHIBIT 1-2: TOTAL UNEMPLOYMENT RATE, 2016 TO 2025, ANNUAL AVERAGE**, displaying seasonally-adjusted unemployment figures ranging from 1.9% to 2.9% over the decade.

This page details Singapore's Fixed Asset Investments (FAI) in manufacturing, featuring **EXHIBIT 1-4: TOTAL MANUFACTURING FAI BY INDUSTRY CLUSTER, 2016 TO 2025** which presents a table and chart reporting industry-specific values in millions of dollars. The data indicates that the Electronics sector attracted approximately S\$4.7 billion (38.5% of total) in 2025, down from S\$7.7 billion in 2024, while other sectors including Chemicals, Biomedical Manufacturing, Precision Engineering, Transport Engineering, and General Manufacturing contributed S\$1.3 billion, S\$4.4 billion, S\$888.0 million, S\$677.1 million, and S\$240.1 million respectively out of a total S\$12.1 billion manufacturing FAI.

This page features Exhibit 1-5, a table detailing the Total Manufacturing Foreign Affluent Investment (FAI) by industry cluster for 2025 with investment commitments in US dollars ($M), year-over-year changes from 2023, and market share percentages.

This page presents the economic outlook for 2026 and Singapore's maritime sector performance, featuring **EXHIBIT 1-7: TOTAL AIR AND SEA CARGO HANDLED IN SINGAPORE, 2016 TO 2025** reporting air cargo in '000 Tonnes (LHS) and sea cargo in '000 Tonnes (RHS). The report details projected GDP growth moderations for key trading partners, specific sector impacts including electronics and aerospace, and global risks such as Middle East conflicts affecting shipping flows.

This page presents market data on private factory space through **EXHIBIT 3-2**, a table and chart detailing net new supply, net new demand, and average occupancy rates from 2021 to 2025 in '000 sf and %, and **EXHIBIT 3-3**, a table listing selected major private factory completions in Q1–Q4 2025 with development names, locations, planning regions, developers, and approximate gross floor areas (sf).

The page presents EXHIBIT 3-4: POTENTIAL SUPPLY OF PRIVATE FACTORY SPACE, a table detailing the projected Gross Floor Area in '000 sf for new supply from 2026 to 2029, alongside EXHIBIT 3-5: UPCOMING MAJOR PRIVATE FACTORY DEVELOPMENTS IN 2026, which lists specific projects including Skye@Tuas, PaxOcean Shipyard @ 5JS, and Equinix SG6 Data Center with their respective locations, developers, and approximate GFA.

This page presents market rent and price indices for JTC factory space as of Q4 2025, featuring **EXHIBIT 3-6: JTC Rental Indices of Factory Space by Types** (covering 2016–2025) and **EXHIBIT 3-7: JTC Price Indices of Factory Space by Types** (covering 2016–2025). The data indicates year-on-year rental index increases of 0.3% for multiple-user and 0.8% for single-user factories, with median rents reaching S\$2.46 psf per month and S\$1.82 psf per month respectively, alongside price index rises of 5.8% and 2.6% leading to median prices of S\$548 psf and S\$230 psf.

The page presents Exhibit 3-8, a table titled "SELECTED MAJOR PRIVATE FACTORY INVESTMENT SALES IN 2025" listing individual property valuations in S$ million for sales of private factories and data centres.

This page presents a market overview of Singapore's private warehouse sector, featuring **EXHIBIT 3-9: Net New Supply, Net New Demand and Average Occupancy of Private Warehouse Space** which details annual data from 2021 to 2025 in '000 sf. The text highlights that as at Q4 2025, total private warehouse stock was 126.2 million sf with an occupancy rate of 90.6%, driven by significant new supply completions including Schenker, DSV Pearl, and Mapletree Joo Koon Logistics Hub.

This page presents Exhibit 3-10 detailing selected major private warehouse completions in 2025 and Exhibit 3-11 outlining upcoming major warehouse developments from 2026 to 2029, both organized by year, location, planning region, developer, and approximate Gross Floor Area (GFA) in square feet.

This page presents market analysis data including a table of potential private warehouse space supply from 2026 to 2029 and a line chart with a corresponding table for the JTC Rental Index of Warehouse Space from 2016 to 2025. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as S$ (Singapore dollars) for rent figures, while property area is measured in '000 sf.

This page presents **EXHIBIT 3-14: Average Unit Price of Private Warehouse Space**, a table reporting strata warehouse prices in S$ psf from 2016 to 2025, alongside narrative data on transaction volumes and highlights from **EXHIBIT 3-15: Selected Major Private Warehouse Investment Sales in 2025** listing six specific deals with sale prices, areas, unit prices, tenure, and dates.
